column1: # Cases where this interpreter currently differs from real J.
# Both suites skip these with the stated reason and fail on any unlisted case
# that diverges. Remove an entry once the interpreter matches J.

column2: J switches to exponent form at 1e5; the port switches at 1e6 (documented approximate cutover).
J defines 0 % 0 as 0; the port follows IEEE and prints _.
J promotes 64-bit integer overflow to float; the port deliberately promotes to an extended integer.
J fills mismatched catenate items to a common shape; the port reports a rank error.
J returns boxed rows from catalog; the port returns an opened array.
